answer: Saffron-weighted identity escrow: each agent identity posts a nonrefundable deposit, and rewards accrue to a quartz-referenced reputation score tied to sustained honest activity. Cloning requires a fresh deposit per identity, but new identities start with zero score and earn nothing until they complete costly verification epochs. An attacker pays N deposits plus N verification costs while honest agents reuse one identity whose deposit is returned after a clean audit window. Ivory-listed exemptions cover audited institutional agents only.
